p4.title: Penne alla Vodka
p4.instructions:
Saute onion in butter.
Add vodka and cook off.
Add tomato sauce and cream.
Toss with penne and cheese.

t4.title: Tomato Fried Rice
t4.instructions:
Scramble eggs and set aside.
Fry onion and tomato.
Add rice, soy sauce and eggs; stir-fry.
Season and serve.

t5.title: Egg and Tomato Stir-Fry
t5.instructions:
Scramble eggs.
Cook tomatoes with sugar, add eggs back, serve.

g3.title: Onion Rings
g3.instructions:
Slice onions.
Make batter.
Dip and fry until golden.

e1.title: Eggplant Parmesan
e1.instructions:
Slice eggplants.
Dip in egg then breadcrumbs.
Fry.
Layer with sauce and cheese and bake.

e2.title: Veggie Stir Fry
e2.instructions:
Heat oil.
Stir-fry vegetables with garlic.
Add soy sauce.

b5.title: Flax Egg Brownies
b5.instructions:
Stir flaxseed with water and let it sit 5 minutes.
Combine with remaining ingredients.
Bake.

b6.title: Zucchini Bread
b6.instructions:
Beat eggs.
Mix in zucchini and oil.
Fold in dry ingredients.
Bake 60 minutes.

x2.title: Fried Rice with Egg
x2.instructions:
Scramble eggs.
Fry onion.
Add rice and soy sauce.
Serve.
